description: This file defines the TritonEmbeddingConfig class which provides configuration and transformation methods for interacting with a Triton-based embedding endpoint. It includes methods for request transformation, response parsing, environment validation, and error handling, specifically for embedding models.

classes.name: TritonEmbeddingConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Triton embedding transformations, including request/response transformation and environment validation.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps OpenAI parameters to Triton embedding parameters.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Validates the environment before making requests based on headers, model, messages, and parameters.

methods.name: dict transform_embedding_request( self, model: str, input: AllEmbeddingInputValues, optional_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms input data into the format required for Triton embedding requests.

methods.name: EmbeddingResponse transform_embedding_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: EmbeddingResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, api_key: Optional[str] = None, request_data: dict = {}, optional_params: dict = {}, litellm_params: dict = {}, )
methods.description: Parses and processes the raw response from Triton embedding API into structured embedding data.

methods.name: BaseLLMException get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[dict, httpx.Headers] )
methods.description: Returns the appropriate exception class for errors encountered during API interaction.

methods.description: Splits a flat list of embedding data into sublists based on the specified shape.
